text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back from an outing—
That neighborhood kid from before came
rushing straight toward me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
—Big sisteeeer!
Let's playyy!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "You're in wonderfully high spirits today as well! Of course, I shall accompany you!"
choice_data_list: You two have become great friends.
You two are practically inseparable now, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes! To tell the truth, we are none other than the neighborhood's strongest Princess Sisters!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text: That is right-wa!

To the point of even picking up her way of speaking,
the neighborhood boss kid seems to deeply respect Kawakami Princess.
Their relationship is just like—
choice_data_list: Just like you and King Halo.
It's just like you and King Halo.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wha-agh?! I-I have never even considered
such an idea before, ever...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, thinking about it that way, it's a huge responsibility...!
How this little one grows up is all up to me...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
? What's wrong, Sis?
Come on, let's go play already!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I must raise her into a magnificent princess...!
Whatever should I teach her
to guide her down the finest path...?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What would King do
at a time like this, I wonder...
Hnnnnghhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Imaginary King
text_block_list.text:
—You seem troubled,
Kawakami-san—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: !? Y-You're... King?!

text_block_list.name: Imaginary King
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, I am the King who dwells
within your mind... Never mind that, listen closely.
I shall impart my advice to you now.”

text_block_list.name: Imaginary King
text_block_list.text: This is the scene where... first, we teach her how to act like a proper princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, as expected of King-san...
Or rather, Imaginary King-san...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! It is decided!
First, let us practice how a princess should properly hold her chopsticks!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text: What's that, playing house?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? T-This is not playing house!
This is my first step
toward becoming a proper princess...!

text_block_list.name: Imaginary King
text_block_list.text:
Don't falter...
Right now, you are an educator—!

—However, Kawakami Princess's passionate guidance
didn't seem to sit well with the little bully... and time passed with the two remaining completely out of sync.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess, even when partaking in cheap sweets,
must do so with grace and modesty—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
—I can't take this anymore! Sis is being so weird today!
She's suddenly nagging me about every little thing just like Mom does!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
T-This is for your own good, you know!
Why won't you just listen to me?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
"No way! Because...
—this isn't like the big sis I love at all!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: Maybe I tried a bit too hard to act grown-up...
Maybe I tried a bit too hard to act grown-up...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, that is true. True princesshood is
not about superficial reasoning...!
It is something shown with one's own back!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Listen closely, everyone.
Right now... I shall leap right over
that jungle gym over there!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That's impossible!?
No way, no way!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Precisely! It is *because* it seems impossible that it holds meaning!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —HYAAAAAHHH!!!!

And with a running start,
Kawakami Princess brilliantly leapt clean over the jungle gym!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa...! That's my big sis!
Your jumping power is the strongest too...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No! What matters is not the fact
that you were jumped over!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Facing up against what seems impossible!
That is the princess's creed! It is the secret
to achieving something truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Did that... get my point across, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text: —Right!!
choice_data_list: You've become quite the princess, haven't you?
Isn't that a little too wild...?
Isn't that a little too wild...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text: —Right!!
choice_data_list: You've become quite the princess, haven't you?
Isn't that a little too wild...?
Isn't that a little too wild...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~... After all, I've been undergoing
training to be a princess under Trainer's guidance!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
All right, then I shall show you an even cooler back!
Next time, maybe I'll jump over the slide and the jungle gym at the same time!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text: Ooh! I wanna see, I wanna see~!

Hastily stopping Kawakami Princess by assuring her she had already shown more than enough of a princess's leading back,
they wrapped up for the day—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, why would you say that?!
I thought I demonstrated what a princess is in the clearest way possible!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I was really moved!
Saying stuff like that is totally uncalled for!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Right~, isn't that so~♪

—At any rate, the bond between the princess
and her pupil seems to have deepened!
